paragraphs.zh:
发明名称
一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法
paragraphs.en: Title of invention: A process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid
paragraphs.notes: Printed across two lines, breaking after 苯甲 so that 酸的制备方法 starts the second line; recorded here unwrapped. 烷氧基 is the generic 'alkoxy', not a specific ether, so the title compound is a family and not one molecule. No structure is drawn on this page.

paragraphs.zh:
摘要
本发明涉及一种2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备方法，所述方法包括以下步骤：原料2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯在碱性物质存在下于三级醇溶剂中发生酯解反应得到2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐；2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐在碱性物质存在下与醇反应或者将2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐与碱金属醇盐反应，得到所述2-氯-3-烷氧基甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸。本发明提供的制备方法以三级醇为溶剂，原料在碱性物质存在下发生酯解反应，降低了杂质的含量，目标化合物的收率和品质得到了大幅的提升，为最终合成高品质环磺酮和呋喃磺草酮原药提供了保障。
paragraphs.en: Abstract. The present invention relates to a process for the preparation of 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid, the process comprising the following steps: the starting material methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate undergoes an ester cleavage reaction in a tertiary alcohol solvent in the presence of a basic substance to give a 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt; the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alcohol in the presence of a basic substance, or alternatively the 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate salt is reacted with an alkali metal alkoxide, to give the said 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid. In the preparation process provided by the present invention a tertiary alcohol is used as the solvent and the starting material undergoes the ester cleavage reaction in the presence of a basic substance, which lowers the content of impurities; the yield and the quality of the target compound are greatly raised, which provides a safeguard for the final synthesis of high quality tembotrione and tefuryltrione technical material.
paragraphs.notes: PUNCTUATION CAVEAT, recorded rather than resolved. The PDF text layer encodes the abstract's separators as FULL-WIDTH: U+FF0C '，', U+FF1A '：', U+FF1B '；', with a full-width U+3002 '。' as the sentence-final stop. Inspected at 3x zoom, the glyphs actually drawn for the comma, colon and semicolon are HALF-WIDTH forms sitting on the baseline with justification space after them, while the final stop is drawn as a true full-width ideographic circle. The zh field follows the text layer codepoints, because those are the characters the document encodes; a purely visual read of this page would report ',' ':' ';' instead. Worth knowing that the reference run CN104292137A recorded the half-width reading for the same CNIPA abstract renderer, so the two runs will differ here on punctuation width in the abstract and nowhere else. The hyphens ARE half-width U+002D in both the text layer and the glyphs, and no space characters appear inside the abstract at all, so the wrapped lines are joined with no separator. TRANSLATION NOTE: 酯解反应 is translated literally as 'ester cleavage reaction'. It is the cleavage of the methyl ester to the carboxylate; whether the patent means saponification or trans-esterification into the tertiary alcohol is not settled by the abstract and must be read off the description. 三级醇 is 'tertiary alcohol'. 碱性物质 is left as the generic 'basic substance' because no specific base is named. 原药 is the agrochemical term for technical-grade active ingredient. NAME NOTE: 环磺酮 is translated as tembotrione and 呋喃磺草酮 as tefuryltrione. Those identifications come from Chinese agrochemical common-name usage, NOT from anything drawn or spelled out on this page. They are self-consistent with the title compound: both herbicides carry a 2-chloro-3-(alkoxymethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoyl unit, tembotrione with the 2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy ether and tefuryltrione with the tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxy ether, which is exactly why the title names a generic alkoxy. Note also that the reference run CN104292137A spells its herbicide 环磺草酮 (with the 草 character) while this patent spells it 环磺酮 (without it); both are used in Chinese for tembotrione, but the difference is recorded here rather than normalised.
